column1: # mapping_set_title: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 to MITRE D3FEND Mappings

# mapping_set_description: Mappings between ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A technological controls and MITRE D3FEND defensive countermeasure concepts. D3FEND is published as an OWL ontology under https://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#; the d3f prefix is used. Predicates - skos:closeMatch where one D3FEND countermeasure substantively implements an Annex A control objective; skos:relatedMatch where D3FEND coverage is partial or technology-specific. These mappings enable the chain ATT&CK technique → D3FEND countermeasure → iso27001 SecurityControl for automated gap analysis.
